item.title: MCP and the Shift to AI Systems
item.description:
Author: Ryan Dougherty
Date: December 18, 2025
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Cybersecurity", "AI Security", "Model Context Protocol", "Enterprise Technology"]
Summary:
  • AI is evolving into fully connected systems with the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • MCP links models directly to tools, data, and workflows.
  • This creates new security risks and expands the attack surface.
  • Threat actors exploit MCP servers and tools for malicious purposes.
  • Limited runtime visibility hinders detection and response.
  • Continuous AI runtime security is critical for protecting MCP ecosystems.

item.title: Zed IDE Vulnerabilities & Coordinated Disclosure The Mindgard solution identified two vulnerabilities in the Zed IDE and our team worked with the developers on a coordinated remediation process.
item.description:
Author: Aaron Portnoy
Date: December 18, 2025
Tags: ["Cybersecurity", "Software Vulnerabilities", "Integrated Development Environments", "AI Security", "Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure"]
Summary:
  • Mindgard found two high severity vulnerabilities in the Zed IDE.
  • The flaws allowed arbitrary code execution from malicious repositories.
  • Mindgard worked closely with Zed developers on fixes.
  • Zed released an update and coordinated disclosure followed.
  • The issues stemmed from implicit trust in project configuration files.
  • This highlights risks in AI-augmented IDEs trusting workspace files.
